messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] autodiff competition heating up:  Torch
parts:
Oh, and this is a very nice summary from one of the Torch
authors:

http://alexey.radul.name/ideas/2013/introduction-to-automatic-differentiation/

You'll be happy to know we hit all their desiderata
with our implementation, including handling what they
call "perturbation confusion", for which I just went with
what seemed like an obvious solution never having seen
the problem mentioned before. I think the author underestimates
the cleverness of the modern C++ compiler. I'll also write
to him about how we handle custom derivatives "gracefully",
or at least as gracefully as is possible with reverse-mode.

I wrote them a note letting them know about Stan so they can
at least mention it along with other existing systems.

- Bob
